A unique developer-approved later intent revision linked to the exact Conflict Report may resolve the conflict and allow execution to resume.
Historical Conflict Report and blocked Work State evidence remain canonical after resolution and do not become permanent blockers.

Conflict Report remains reserved for intent-versus-feasibility incompatibility and is not used for ordinary route changes, environment failures, or recoverable verification failures.

Dedicated fresh review reports no remaining Critical or Important findings after remediation.
